about_the_game:
The Northwind Legion Gear includes an exclusive armor and a set of trinkets that help boost character strength in the early game.

Outfit: Northwind Tempest Set
The armor of a recognised Northwind Legion warrior. Traditionally, all warriors of the Northwind Legion had to pass the Trial of Tempest. This armor set, masterfully crafted by Anbari, can withstand any harsh conditions.

Trinket: Brooch of the Warhound
Crafted in the shape of their family’s beloved warhound, this wooden brooch was given to Hilda on her 5th birthday by her brother Carl. It's also one of the few items that help her with the remembrance of her sibling who has passed away.

Trinket: Northwind Medallion
This medallion was presented to Hilda when she completed her first assignment after becoming a Northwind Legion warrior. Commander Harold personally handed it to her as a token of praise and a reminder to always keep her composure as a true grown up warrior.
